The default main account is system admin, which has all the operation permissions of the product. The system admin can add more sub\-account users according to the following operations and grant corresponding permissions to the users. After completing the permissions, the sub\-account can log in to the product to quickly use the agent.

<img src="data:image/svg+xml;base64," />

<span id="1c10cfca"></span>
# Administrator login instructions


1. Administrators can click the [BytePlus login page](https://console.byteplus.com/auth/signup?redirectURI=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.byteplus.com%2Fen&skipAccountProfile=true) to sign up or sign in.

   <span>![图片](https://p9-arcosite.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-goo7wpa0wc/4aed886d8cd14b1f962e68f4ae5bdf31~tplv-goo7wpa0wc-image.image) </span>

2. After entering the login page, the right side of the page is the login operation area. By default, account login and Google login are supported in two ways:

   * **Account login**: Enter the username, email or main account(**usually a 10\-digit group starting with 3**) and the corresponding password to log in.

   * **Google login:**  Use the Google account bound to the main account to complete the login through the verification code.

      <span>![图片](https://p9-arcosite.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-goo7wpa0wc/4088a4d331114309946745eda28ec653~tplv-goo7wpa0wc-image.image) </span>

3. Below the login button are several secondary entries, including **Forgot your password**, **IAM user** and **Enterprise federation login**. Among them, **IAM user login** is used to switch to the [sub-user login page](https://signin.byteplus.com/auth/login/user/?redirectURI=https%3A%2F%2Fconsole.byteplus.com%2Fuser%2Fbasics%2F), which is suitable for IAM sub\-account login created and authorized by the administrator.

4. If the current login person is not the main account administrator, but a sub\-account user, you need to click the [IAM sub-user login ](https://signin.byteplus.com/auth/login/user/?redirectURI=https%3A%2F%2Fconsole.byteplus.com%2Fuser%2Fbasics%2F)button below the dialog box to jump to the sub\-account login page.


<div data-tips="true" data-tips-type="tip" data-tips-is-title="true">tip</div>


<div data-tips="true" data-tips-type="tip">The administrator's main account has high administrative permissions and can perform management operations such as account, resources, permissions, and security configuration. In order to ensure the security of the account, it is recommended that the administrator properly keep the main account information to avoid multiple people sharing the main account.</div>


<span id="962618be"></span>
# Overall process

System admin can refer to the following steps to add users and grant users the corresponding permissions to quickly use the agent, please refer to more permission information [Permission Management](https://docs.byteplus.com/docs/dataagent/Permission_Management).


|Step |Corresponding location |Description |
|---|---|---|
|[Add system members](https://docs.byteplus.com/docs/dataagent/Intelligent_Analysis_Agent_Administrator_Quick_Start_Guide#586c7a05) |**BytePlus Access Control** |The system member is a member of the BytePlus system, which is a sub\-account. You can log in to the BytePlus system with the sub\-account username and password. |
|Allocation of seats |**Admin Background \- Member List** |Add product seats for system members to become product members and have basic permission to use iDA.<br><br><div data-tips="true" data-tips-type="warning" data-tips-is-title="true">warning</div><br><br><br><div data-tips="true" data-tips-type="warning">Allocating seats requires a remaining seat to be allocated, otherwise it cannot be added. Please ensure that you have a remaining seat available before allocating it. View the current and remaining seats on the member management page.</div><br> |
|Distribution of points (optional) |**Usage Management \- Adjust Limits** |To control member usage, you can allocate credits to them for resource consumption, such as iDA invokes. |
|[Grant project resource permissions](https://docs.byteplus.com/docs/dataagent/Intelligent_Analysis_Agent_Administrator_Quick_Start_Guide#6d4c086c) |**Project Center** |Product members must have at least permissions to view the project dataset before they can use agents configured with that dataset. |
|[Grant agent permission](https://docs.byteplus.com/docs/dataagent/Intelligent_Analysis_Agent_Administrator_Quick_Start_Guide#bfe427a7) |**Agent Configuration \- Basic Information** |Product members must have at least agent viewing permissions before they can use the agent. |


<span id="586c7a05"></span>
# Add system members

The default main account is system admin, and the sub\-accounts are system members. The main account has the permission to create sub\-accounts, and BytePlus system members can be added by creating sub\-accounts.


1. Log in to iDA with the system admin account, click on the user avatar, and select **IAM**.

   <span>![图片](https://p9-arcosite.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-goo7wpa0wc/b7f2ab67a70f4859a19c8b1bb6e26e25~tplv-goo7wpa0wc-image.image) </span>

2. Add BytePlus system members (sub\-accounts). Click "User" \- "Create New User", follow the prompts to add sub\-accounts. For specific steps, refer to [Creating an IAM User](https://docs.volcengine.com/docs/IAM/Usermanagement-9?lang=en#%E6%96%B0%E5%BB%BA%E7%94%A8%E6%88%B7).

   <span>![图片](https://p9-arcosite.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-goo7wpa0wc/10f6b8b4ae3a4fd4998855576d8cfb7d~tplv-goo7wpa0wc-image.image) </span>

   * **Create New User:**  Click the Create New User button to enter the configuration process, enter Basic information settings \> Permission settings \> Review \> Done. To add in bulk, click the Add User button under the form to add multiple users.

      <span>![图片](https://p9-arcosite.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-goo7wpa0wc/dc646a0dd7cf47408ad706cb91341a3d~tplv-goo7wpa0wc-image.image) </span>

      
      |Configuration item |Description |
      |---|---|
      |Basic information |Fill in the user information, including username (required), email address, display name, description, and tags. |
      |Access method |Select the access method and support multiple selection.<br><br><br>* Programmatic access: Assign an Access Key to a user and access it through the Request API.<br><br>* Console access: Assign a password to the user and access it by logging into the console.<br><br>   * Access Password: Select Automatically Generate Password/Custom Generate Password. When selecting Generate Password for Custom, you need to set the access password.<br><br>   * Reset Password: Select Reset Password/No Password Reset when you log in next time.<br><br>   * MFA settings(Multi\-Factor Authentication settings): Select to enable secondary authentication when logging in/No need to use multi\-factor authentication for login |
      


<span id="b031139c"></span>
# Allocation of seats

After adding the IAM sub\-account in the previous step, you need to assign a seat to the sub\-account before you can use iDA normally. Allocation of seats requires the main account to enter the iDA main page, mouse click on the lower left corner of the user name, select **management background \- member management \- invite members,**  enter the sub\-account user name added in the previous step to determine, you can allocate seats.

<div data-tips="true" data-tips-type="warning" data-tips-is-title="true">warning</div>


<div data-tips="true" data-tips-type="warning">Added sub\-accounts do not support repeated addition. To view all sub\-accounts under the current main account, please go to " <strong>Management Center \- User Management</strong> Office".</div>


<span>![图片](https://p9-arcosite.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-goo7wpa0wc/43c78118778d4a969c6f09c4f8574beb~tplv-goo7wpa0wc-image.image) </span>

<span>![图片](https://p9-arcosite.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-goo7wpa0wc/896f76a4ba594a078017753fe75aba82~tplv-goo7wpa0wc-image.image) </span>

<span id="decc7e5c"></span>
# Create project


1. After purchasing the iDA service, use the account password to [log in to the iDA ](https://signin.byteplus.com/auth/login/?redirectURI=https%3A%2F%2Fconsole.byteplus.com%2Fuser%2Fbasics%2F)interface.

   <span>![图片](https://p9-arcosite.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-goo7wpa0wc/9b4bbf699c1f41edba19178d7988d8d8~tplv-goo7wpa0wc-image.image) </span>

2. After entering the product page, select the corresponding region, click the New Project button at the top right of the page, fill in the project name, select the project administrator, and fill in the reason for creation field. Click the OK button after completion.

3. After the creation is successful, the page will be redirected to the Project Center. Click the'User Management 'tab and click the **Add User** button to authorize.

   <span>![图片](https://p9-arcosite.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-goo7wpa0wc/b5a622eae2824567b197962a9a7a2bad~tplv-goo7wpa0wc-image.image) </span>


<span id="6d4c086c"></span>
# Grant project resource permissions

Assign relevant project resource permissions to product members so that they can perform a series of operations on project resources, including datasets, data connections, and visual modeling. Support for authorizing individual users or groups of users.


* Authorize for a single user:

   Enter the specific project interface, click "Project Center" \- "User Management", click "Add User", search for the sub\-account username, name or email address here, grant the user project\-related permissions, and click "OK".

   <span>![图片](https://p9-arcosite.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-goo7wpa0wc/de9a5c366c544e538a5e0688e61df581~tplv-goo7wpa0wc-image.image) </span>

   * If the user is granted "administrative permission" and "global viewing permission" for the project. You can view all datasets within the project without granting additional dataset permissions.

   * If the user item is granted "view permission" and "edit permission". Only authorized datasets can be viewed, and additional permissions for datasets need to be granted. Click "User Authorization", select the specific dataset to be authorized, and at least grant "View Permissions" for the dataset before using the agent configured with the corresponding dataset.

      <span>![图片](https://p9-arcosite.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-goo7wpa0wc/782625b9c5b54f4daea2628a34514d9a~tplv-goo7wpa0wc-image.image) </span>

* To authorize a user group (optional):

   1. Create a user group. User groups are created by system admin on the [IAM access control page](https://console.byteplus.com/iam/identitymanage/usergroup), i.e. system\-level user groups, see [User Management](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6257/64977).

      <span>![图片](https://p9-arcosite.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-goo7wpa0wc/ba182f313f174fd59e908ee26c321bdb~tplv-goo7wpa0wc-image.image) </span>

   2. Add a user to a user group. For adding users to user groups by system admin, see [IAM access control page](https://console.byteplus.com/iam/identitymanage/usergroup).

      <span>![图片](https://p9-arcosite.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-goo7wpa0wc/ea90a22e13c5471ca818b06102bcce6c~tplv-goo7wpa0wc-image.image) </span>

   3. Associate user groups. The project administrator creates a new user group in the product by associating a system\-level user group in the "User Group List" on the "Project Center" \- "User Group Management" page.

      <div data-tips="true" data-tips-type="warning" data-tips-is-title="true" data-wrapper-indent="2">warning      </div>
      

      * <div data-tips="true" data-tips-type="warning" data-wrapper-indent="2">Here <strong>project administrators</strong> can only create user groups in iDA by associating system\-level user groups, which are the user groups set in <a href="https://console.byteplus.com/iam/identitymanage/user">BytePlus IAM Access Control</a>.      </div>
      

      * <div data-tips="true" data-tips-type="warning" data-wrapper-indent="2">To adjust system\-level user group membership, <strong>system admin</strong> adds and removes users from the <a href="https://console.byteplus.com/iam/identitymanage/user">IAM access control page</a>.      </div>
      

   4. Authorize the user group. Project or dataset permissions are granted to user groups by the project administrator in the "Rights Management" section of the "Project Center" \- "User Group Management" page, see [User Group Management](https://docs.byteplus.com/docs/dataagent/User_Group_Management).

      <span>![图片](https://p9-arcosite.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-goo7wpa0wc/df49cbd3e32e41e0938a93002f3a5f27~tplv-goo7wpa0wc-image.image) </span>


<span id="bfe427a7"></span>
# Grant agent permission

Assign specific agent\-related permissions to product members, allowing users to use or manage related agents. Or users can create their own agents for use.

In the agent list interface, select a specific agent to be authorized, and click "Agent Configuration" to enter the agent configuration interface. Click "Basic Information" to choose to grant sub\-account agent administrator privileges or agent ordinary member privileges.


* Agent administrator privileges. Click "Edit", add a sub\-account in "Agent Administrator", and click "Save" after the addition is successful. Agent administrators can perform actions such as creating, editing, configuring, deleting, publishing, going offline, adding members, and adding other administrators.

   <span>![图片](https://p9-arcosite.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-goo7wpa0wc/0c0a29c0d9624a7e9c834bc08d6a537d~tplv-goo7wpa0wc-image.image) </span>

* Agent normal member permissions. Click "Add Member", search for the sub\-account username, and click "OK" after the addition is successful. The normal member of the agent only has the query usage permission of the agent and cannot edit the agent.

   <span>![图片](https://p9-arcosite.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-goo7wpa0wc/f55fc76a8309497bbc7ff38a363f3783~tplv-goo7wpa0wc-image.image) </span>
